svg.title: B04 / AURORA VEIL — Ionospheric Absorption Atlas engineering mission profile
svg.desc: B04, AURORA VEIL — Ionospheric Absorption Atlas. Original project: Analysis of Space-based Riometer Measurement Data for Characterization of Radio Propagation Disturbance in the Ionosphere. Session B: Earth & Environmental Engineering. Scientific question: How accurately can cleaned riometer observations characterize absorption events and improve event-scale propagation estimates beyond archived model predictions? Testable hypothesis: A stable quiet-day baseline plus interference rejection will improve absorption-event agreement; residual differences will depend on latitude, illumination, antenna pattern and the frequency/path being compared..
